name: Finding A Husband
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is part of God's design to provide companionship and support, as He declared it is not good for man to be alone and created a suitable helper for him. The union between husband and wife is meant to be a close, lasting bond where they become one flesh and leave their parents to cleave to one another. Finding a wife is described as gaining a good and valuable blessing from the Lord, with the virtuous woman being of immeasurable worth. Believers are encouraged to wait on the Lord with courage and trust, recognizing that two working together share a greater reward than one alone.
